reply: Thanks for reaching out, and for the suggestion! I don't have any information indicating that dark mode is currently available or on a published roadmap for Loopwise, so I can't give you a timeline on this. I've noted your feedback so it's on record with the team. In the meantime, if you're using a browser or OS-level dark mode/reader extension, that may help reduce eye strain when using the web app. Let us know if there's anything else we can help with!
